description: This file is a shell script that orchestrates kernel image and module preparation tasks for Android build processes, including sourcing common scripts and calling various prepare functions with specific parameters.

methods.name: prepare_lz4
methods.description: Initializes or prepares LZ4 compression layer (defined in sourced script).

methods.name: prepare_kernel_image
methods.description: Prepares a kernel image with specified parameters such as artifact name, version, architecture, and optional debug info.

methods.name: prepare_kernel_modules
methods.description: Prepares kernel modules given an artifact, version, and architecture.
